name: Formation of the Ideology of Great-Power Chauvinism (1864–1876) (C0063)

techniques.comment: The systematic imposition of the metropole's logic of superiority. Researchers reconstruct Katkov's logic thus: "a nation must be a tribe capable of creating a state; only a state nation can establish order in a given territory; tribes incapable of creating a state have to submit to the state nation"(Citation: Политический национализм М. Н. Каткова 2018). Katkov himself wrote: "In the recognition of a nation the question of power, of government, of the state is decided"(Citation: Политический национализм М. Н. Каткова 2018). Hrushevsky records both the thesis and its reach: Valuev invoked an imaginary "majority of Little Russians" who allegedly "know neither a Ukrainian nationality nor language, only one Russian people and tongue," while the ideology's mouthpieces carried it to the formula "there are no Ruthenians — there is only one 'Russian people' from the Carpathians to Kamchatka"(Citation: Ілюстрована історія України 1921).

The use of Ukrainians within the imperial army in large-scale wars of conquest in the Caucasus and Central Asia – recruit conscription had extended to the Ukrainian governorates since the liquidation of the autonomy(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012).
